about.title: About
about.heading: A house building fragrances that tell stories
about.paragraph1: Crave is an Egyptian brand specialized in crafting luxury perfumes. We believe a fragrance is more than a scent — it is an expression of character and a story you tell.
about.paragraph2: We select the finest ingredients and master craftsmanship in every detail, to offer you perfumes that last and leave an unforgettable impression.
about.value1Text: Designs and scents that reflect timeless elegance and sophistication.
about.value2Text: Careful selection of ingredients for the best experience.
about.value3Text: Proud of local craftsmanship and the authenticity of Egyptian identity.

story.title: Our Story
story.heading: The Crave journey
story.paragraph1: The idea of Crave began with a passion for the art of perfumery, and a desire to offer something different that expresses elegance with a local touch.
story.paragraph2: From the careful selection of ingredients to the luxurious packaging, every step in our journey is driven by a love of the craft and a pursuit of perfection.
story.mission: To make every person feel distinguished through a fragrance that carries their own story.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.heading: We'd love to hear from you
contact.subtitle: For any inquiry about your order or our fragrances, feel free to reach out.
